output.summary: Biennial or perennial flowering herb native to northern and central Europe, red campion has hairy, slightly sticky stems and leaves. Its deeply notched dark pink to red flowers appear from May to October, with male and female flowers on separate plants. Young leaves and flowers are edible, though cooking or blanching is recommended to remove their bitter aftertaste.
